page.overview:
Who is World Grand Prix Racers?

The World Grand Prix racers are supporting characters that appeared in Cars 2.

These racers were chosen by Sir Miles Axlerod to promote his new alternative fuel, Allinol, in an international racing competition called the World Grand Prix. The competition unites the 11 best racers in the world in order to determine who is the world's fastest car. Though there are 12 spots in each race, there is actually an odd number of 11 racers.

At the Wheel Well Motel in Radiator Springs, the residents and vistors watched on TV The Mel Dorado Show when Miles Axlerod announced that he's going to be organizing a racing competition called the "World Grand Prix", Francesco Bernoulli appeared on the show and talked about Lightning McQueen, later McQueen gets trash-talked by Francesco and later McQueen trash-talks to him because Lightning challenges Francesco to race in the World Grand Prix.

After the travelling to Tokyo, Japan, Lightning greets Lewis Hamilton and Jeff Gorvette at the Tokyo Art Museum, but Mater and McQueen met Francesco Bernoull, later Lightning was the last one to be interviewed by Axlerod, but when Mater runned to drink water, the other racers looked bad at him but Francesco laughs at McQueen.
